verdict.rationale: Highnote is API-first: the full payment lifecycle, card issuance, and spend rules are available via its GraphQL API with one key and one endpoint, plus a typed Node SDK, so it runs without any UI. Its test environment replicates live functionality and can simulate authorizations, refunds, and statements, which supports automated testing pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance, a CLI or headless tooling, a stable (non-beta) SDK, an OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
